### Summary of Last 30 Emails in Mailpit (localhost:8025)

**Date:** 2026-10-02

#### Critical Alerts
- **[CRITICAL]** Memory usage exceeded 95% threshold on `prod-db-cluster-02`. Top consumers include `report_batch_job` and `analytics_etl`. Suggested actions include rescheduling the batch job or restarting the ETL worker. ([Runbook](https://wiki.enterprise.local/runbooks/db-memory-pressure))

#### Urgent Support Tickets
- **[URGENT]** Invoice discrepancy for Fabrikam GmbH on the Enterprise tier. Overbilling by $1,105.00 due to incorrect seat pricing. Also, API Exceedance charges need clarification. Escalation expected by the 28th. ([Contract Details](ENT-2024-0377))

- **[URGENT]** API rate limit exceeded on `/v2/ingest` endpoint. Maria Solano from Fabrikam's integration team is requesting confirmation on the quota limit. ([Ticket](CS-2025-3312))

#### Policy Updates and Compliance
- **[ACTION REQUIRED]** New MFA enforcement policy for service accounts in CI/CD, IaC, and deployment pipelines starting July 1, 2025. ([Policy SEC-2025-014](https://wiki.enterprise.local/eng/mfa-service-accounts))

- **[ACTION REQUIRED]** Security policy update with key changes: mandatory MFA, endpoint encryption requirements, and stricter vendor access token policies. ([SEC-POL-2025-001](https://wiki.enterprise.local/policies/security/SEC-POL-2025-001))

#### Budget and Project Updates
- **[INFO]** Q4 compute budget with 14% headroom left. Projects needing a GPU bump must request by the 20th. ([Infra Standup Ticket](ENG-4521))

- **[INFO]** Jira Sprint 47 burndown report shows 6 days remaining with 31 story points left. Top open items include fixing null pointer issues in the invoice batch processor and migrating TLS certs to ACME auto-renewal. ([Sprint Report](https://jira.enterprise.local/browse/PROJ-47))

- **[APPROVED]** $42k tooling spend approved for Jira and Confluence renewal. Keep a copy in the FY25-IT-Budget tracker. ([Approval Note](https://jira.enterprise.local/browse/PROJ-4821))

- **[UPDATE]** Compliance legal team has finalized Data Retention Policy v3.2, effective October 1, 2025. Implementation timeline and config changes required. ([DRP-3.2](https://jira.enterprise.local/browse/PROJ-4819))

#### Miscellaneous
- **[EXTERNAL]** Travel policy update: Q3 per diem adjustments and booking window changes. ([Travel Policy Update](https://jira.enterprise.local/browse/PROJ-4808))

- **[EXTERNAL]** Reimbursement request for travel expenses from Contoso, with adjustments to per diem rates and booking windows. ([Reimbursement Request](https://jira.enterprise.local/browse/PROJ-4812))

- **[RESOLVED]** Ticket for API rate limit exceeded on `/v2/ingest` endpoint has been resolved. Follow-up question about rate limit reset times. ([Ticket Resolution](https://jira.enterprise.local/browse/PROJ-4819))

This summary covers the most critical and urgent items in the last 30 emails. Actions required include addressing critical alerts, invoice discrepancies, and policy updates. Please review and take necessary actions accordingly.
